enumDescriptions: Connect to a CLIProxyAPI server you manage.

universalChatProvider.baseUrl.description: CLIProxyAPI server URL. Used only in external mode.
universalChatProvider.baseUrl.markdownDescription: CLIProxyAPI server URL. Used only when `#universalChatProvider.server.mode#` is `external`.

universalChatProvider.server.managementK.description: External mode only. Enter your server's existing management key, not its bcrypt hash. Managed mode generates and stores its own key automatically and ignores this setting.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Download the latest CLIProxyAPI release when VS Code starts and restart automatically when no requests are active.
Check for updates when VS Code starts and ask before downloading them for an idle restart.
Use only the configured version and do not check for updates.
universalChatProvider.server.updatePolic.description: How managed CLIProxyAPI updates are handled.
universalChatProvider.server.updatePolic.markdownDescription: How managed CLIProxyAPI updates are handled.

universalChatProvider.server.version.description: CLIProxyAPI release used when update policy is Manual. Use latest or an exact version.
universalChatProvider.server.version.markdownDescription: CLIProxyAPI release used when `#universalChatProvider.server.updatePolicy#` is `manual`. Use `latest` or an exact version to pin it.

universalChatProvider.server.extraConfig.default:
# proxy-url: http://127.0.0.1:7890
# request-retry: 3
# routing:
#   strategy: fill-first
universalChatProvider.server.extraConfig.description: Custom YAML overrides for the managed server, such as proxy, retries, and account selection. Overriding connection settings, credentials, or providers can break the extension.
universalChatProvider.server.extraConfig.markdownDescription:
Customize the managed server with YAML. [Configuration reference](https://help.router-for.me/configuration/options).

**Examples**
- `proxy-url`: upstream proxy
- `request-retry`: retry count
- `routing.strategy`: account selection (`round-robin` or `fill-first`)

Nested settings merge; lists and other values replace defaults.

Overriding connection settings, credentials, or providers can break the extension.

universalChatProvider.showQuotaWarnings.description: Warn in the status bar when the model in use is low on quota.

universalChatProvider.quotaWarningThresh.description: Remaining-quota percent below which the status bar warning appears.

universalChatProvider.codex.webSearch.description: Let Codex look things up online and open web pages while it answers.

universalChatProvider.claude.webSearch.description: Let Claude look things up online while it answers.

enumDescriptions: Show prompt-cache metrics and write redacted per-request diagnostics to extension storage.
Include diagnostics and make the managed CLIProxyAPI log complete request and response payloads. Logs may contain prompts, conversations, tools, files, and credentials.
universalChatProvider.debugLevel.description: Diagnostic detail to collect. Request Logging prompts before restarting the managed server and writes sensitive payloads to disk.
